calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Carvago
calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook sales) discussed Carvago’s need for sticky bucketing in A/B testing—a feature missing in their current open-source version and their previous tool Flexmith. Carvago Sro (an architect) is evaluating GrowthBook Cloud Pro ($40/user/month) versus self-hosted Enterprise, with cost and support being key factors. Next steps: James will send an Enterprise pricing proposal; the architect will review it with Carvago’s CTO and decide within two weeks.
